notablePrerequisites:
You control creatures that can produce at least {W}{W}.
Emry does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate creatures you control by tapping them, adding at least {W}{W}.
Activate Emry by tapping them, allowing you to cast Out of Time from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Out of Time from your graveyard by paying {1}{W}{W}.
Out of Time enters the battlefield.
In response to its trigger, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Out of Time, adding {2}.
Resolve Out of Time's trigger, untapping all creatures then failing to phase them out since Out of Time has left the battlefield.
Repeat.
